newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil gains with futures, but some prems eas.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil gains with futures, but some prems eas.

text.p: NWE gas oil gained up to $3 a tonne on the back of stronger IPE futures, but there were signs of weakness in some grades' premiums, traders said.
April IPE gas oil settled $3.25 stronger at $175 a tonne after a day spent confirming recent gains.

Heating oil barge premiums, however, were lower and DIN premiums also weakened after strong buying at the start of the week waned. Heating oil barges traded as low as April IPE -$2 fob ARA, although some traders thought the price was overdone. Barge traders said there was little fundemental interest with German buying still dormant.
DIN premiums were also pressured lower with a 10,000 tonne cargo into Rostock selling at April IPE +$5.50. This compared with the April IPE +7 and +$6.50 that were traded yesterday.

Russian premiums continued to show firmness with second half March material heard offered at April IPE +$4, about $1 stronger than yesterday. Traders said demand for large cargoes to take east was still evident in the market.
FOD endured another quiet day with bids heard at April +$4 cif and offers at +$5.
A diesel cargo of 10kt was sold at April IPE +$12.50 cif NWE, a broadly unchanged premium from Tuesday.
